name: RankBeyond
author: tusharkapil

sections.description:
RankBeyond is an AI-powered content engine that researches your business, identifies the best keywords, and writes high-quality blog posts for you — then publishes them directly to your WordPress site through this plugin.

This plugin acts as the bridge between your WordPress site and the RankBeyond platform. Once connected, blog posts generated and approved in your RankBeyond dashboard are automatically sent to your WordPress site — either published immediately or saved as drafts for your review.

Key Features:

  • 🔗 One-click connection to your RankBeyond account via API key
  • 📝 Receive AI-written, SEO-optimized blog posts automatically
  • ⚡ Choose to auto-publish or save posts as drafts for review
  • 📊 Built-in dashboard to view all posts received from RankBeyond
  • ✏️ Edit or view any post directly from the plugin’s admin panel
  • 🔒 Secure API key authentication

How it works:

  1. Sign up at rankbeyond.co
  2. Set up your WordPress integration from your RankBeyond dashboard
  3. Install this plugin, enter your API key, and you’re live
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it directly via the WordPress admin panel under Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins page.
  3. Navigate to RankBeyond → Settings in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Enter your API key from your RankBeyond dashboard.
  5. Choose your preferred publish mode — Publish immediately or Save as draft.
  6. Click Save Settings. You’re all set!
sections.faq:
Where do I get my API key?

Log in to your RankBeyond dashboard, go to the Integrations page, select WordPress, and your unique API key will be generated for you.

How does the integration work?

Once you install the plugin and save your API key, RankBeyond can send blog posts directly to your WordPress site. Posts arrive with the title, content, meta description, and featured image already set.

Can I review posts before they go live?

Yes. In the plugin settings, switch the Publish Mode to Save as draft. All incoming posts will land in your drafts for you to review and publish manually.

Is there a cost to use this plugin?

The plugin itself is free. A RankBeyond subscription is required to generate and publish content. Visit rankbeyond.co to see plans.
